issue.summary: Tongxin CLI script path was persisted, but status stayed dependency_missing because v0.2.5 only accepts an EcoreX-owned Python runtime by default.

rootCause: The Tongxin wrapper health probe created a strict ToolExecutionEnvironment without a configurable Python executable, so the configured local CLI could not run when the source checkout did not expose an owned Python at the runtime root.
The external Tongxin script owns adjacent modules such as config.py and models.py; running it through ambient EcoreX Python path state can shadow those modules or produce models.DATABASE failures.
The Windows embedded WebUI Python successfully runs the script when launched through a runpy shim that inserts the Tongxin script directory at sys.path[0].
changes: Added tools.tongxin_cli.python_path support through config, per-call arguments, and environment aliases.
Tongxin schema/data probes and run calls now use the configured EcoreX-owned Python executable when present.
Tongxin CLI execution now uses a runpy shim so the external script directory is first in sys.path.
Tongxin CLI execution clears PYTHONPATH and PYTHONHOME to avoid EcoreX module shadowing.
optional_abilities and agent_capability now pass python_path through the Tongxin configure/install path.
config defaults and config-template expose python_path without changing the read-only default policy.
Local config.json was completed with a redacted EcoreX-owned Python path so this workstation status is configured.
preservedContracts: System Python is still not accepted by default for v0.2.5 tool execution.
Tongxin remains a read-only wrapper; mutating commands are still blocked before subprocess execution.
Status and matrix summaries remain redacted and do not persist raw CLI stdout.
This local fix does not make releaseReady true because the Linux production ecorex service-user probe is still pending.
requiredFollowUps: Run scripts/run-v025-tool-matrix-smoke.py on the Web Linux service as the production ecorex user.
